values.note: Town page: sites C1-C3 (power and water) '$34.00' (no unit given; listed between the seasonal rates and the short-term rate), short-term RV & trailer sites C4-C29 along the river with power, water and sewer '$59.00 a day'. Seasonal sites $850-$1,950 a season plus $200 winter storage. Lean-to $20 a night.

fees.source: https://www.townofwaverlyny.org/campsite ('The following sites are $34.00 C1 through C3: includes power and water.'; 'RV & Trailer Site - Short Term $59.00 a day C4 - C29 ... including power, water, and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.townofwaverlyny.org/campsite (C1-C3 'includes power and water'; C4-C29 'including power, water, and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Call 518-856-9820 from May 1 to September 27, or 518-856-9482 (Town Supervisor) from December 1 to May 1; half the fee within 7 days by mailed check, the balance by April 1. Sites C1-C11 are not seasonal; C12-C29 are seasonal sites.

booking.source: https://www.townofwaverlyny.org/campsite ('There is a 2-day minimum stay on weekends. For reservations, call 518-856-9820 from May 1st through September 27th. For reservations starting December 1st through May 1st please call 518-856-9482.'; 'Sites C1 to C11 are Not Seasonal Sites. Sites C12 to C29 are Seasonal Sites.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Town of Waverly campground (Franklin County) on the St. Regis River below the falls (since 1967). RV, tent, waterfront, lean-to, cabin sites. No wading or swimming. RV Life unrated. --Claude
summary: Town page confirms phone booking, power/water at C1-C3 and full hookups at C4-C29, a 2-night weekend minimum and 11 non-seasonal of 29 RV sites; fees widened from $59 to $34-59 ($34 for C1-C3, unit not stated); no season dates or amperage.
flags: The town campsite page (townofwaverlyny.org) brands itself 'Town of Waverly (UNOFFICIAL)' and gives the address as townofwaverlyny.com, which does not resolve; it is the only operator page found, and the phone 518-856-9820 matches.
Fees: the $34.00 for C1-C3 has no unit on the page; read as a nightly rate it is the base, otherwise the base is the $59/day short-term rate. Check before relying on $34.
